units.source_text: 源氏公子起身，亲自将格子门打开，赏玩庭前花木雪景。

en.t: Prince Genji rose, opened the lattice door himself, and admired the flowers, trees, and snowy scene in the garden.

units.source_text: 荒寂的雪地，一望无际，不见行人足迹，景色实甚凄凉。

en.t: The desolate snow-covered ground stretched endlessly into the distance, with no trace of travelers' footsteps, and the scene was truly bleak.

units.source_text: 然而就此离去，毕竟不好意思。

en.t: Yet to leave just like that would, after all, have felt improper.

units.source_text: 他就恨恨地说：“出来看看早上天空的美景吧！

en.t: So he said resentfully, "Come out and look at the beautiful morning sky!

units.source_text: 老是冷冰冰地不声不响，教人难堪！”

en.t: Always staying so cold and silent only makes things awkward for people!"

units.source_text: 天色还没有大亮，源氏公子映着雪光，姿态异常秀丽，老侍女们看了都笑逐颜开。

en.t: The sky was not yet fully bright, and Prince Genji, lit by the snowlight, looked extraordinarily graceful; the elderly ladies-in-waiting beamed when they saw him.

units.source_text: 她们便劝导小姐：“快快出去吧。

en.t: They then urged the young lady, "Please go out quickly.
It would be discourteous not to go.

units.source_text: 女儿家最要紧的是柔顺。”

en.t: For a young woman, the most important thing is to be gentle and obedient."

units.source_text: 小姐生性不愿拒绝别人的劝告，便整理一下服饰，膝行而出。

en.t: The young lady was naturally unwilling to refuse others' advice, so she adjusted her clothing and moved out on her knees.
